scope: Four synthetic two-PDF fixtures: genuine parsing, original chunking/MiniLM/FAISS/BM25 snapshot creation and verified analysis sampling; MOCKED Groq SSE
reference_checks: Actual original SQL loader functions executed with isolated fixture rows; same L3 counts, prefix limits, L1 preference and space-joined L3 fallback
Actual original comparison/gap functions executed with mocked LLM; complete system and human prompts compared byte-for-byte on all four fixtures
Original contradiction persistence threshold and provider parameters evaluated directly from original AST
Original comparison and knowledge-gap HTML cards evaluated and compared directly
Original all-indexed scope, pair ordering, output fields and model-signal semantics retained
limitations: Mocked findings test plumbing and reference fidelity, NOT live model ability to distinguish contradictions, consistent wording, gaps or unrelated topics
Original analyses sample paragraphs/summaries; they do not prove contradictions or absence throughout complete PDFs and do not perform hybrid retrieval
Peak RSS is native worker lifetime high-water mark after indexing, NOT total Streamlit memory or cloud-host capacity
Analysis latency uses warm native indexes and fixed local HTTP mocks; cold downloads, real Groq latency and large PDFs are not measured
Token figures are pessimistic reservations, not measured provider consumption
No live OAuth, two-browser, Linux or Community Cloud readiness claim
